project_name: Studio di Fattibilità: Smart Pantry AI & Timeline Anti-Spreco

entry_surfaces./: split-view hub: left sticky interactive navigation/progress, top feasibility executive summary banner, middle long-form 7-chapter study with verified/estimate callouts & interactive calculator, right/tabbed live working prototype (receipt upload, OCR edit, pantry timeline, AI recipes, Jarvis morning telegram test)

grids.calculator_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-8 p-6 bg-white rounded-2xl border border-stone-200

motion.modal_entrance: transition-all duration-200 ease-out animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95

accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 44x44px for buttons, chips, and table row actions on mobile viewports
accessibility.data_testids: Mandatory data-testid on every interactive control and result card
accessibility.aria_labels: Explicit aria-label for icon buttons (upload, edit, discard, eat, throw, telegram send)

pantry_hero.description: Donna che organizza la dispensa e scaffali con barattoli ordinati
pantry_hero.placement: Hero section banner & case study context card

pantry_jars.description: Barattoli in vetro per conservazione alimenti e scadenze in dispensa

components_structure.AppHeader: @/components/Header.tsx - Sticky glass header with feasibility title, mode toggle (Studio Completo / Prototipo Interattivo), and reset 'Ricomincia'
components_structure.TableOfContents: @/components/TableOfContents.tsx - Sticky nav with 7 numbered chapters, progress tracking, and jump links
components_structure.VerifiedBadge: @/components/ui/VerifiedBadge.tsx - Pill component distinguishing 'Dato Verificato' (source + date) from 'Stima' (assumptions)
components_structure.CompetitorMatrix: @/components/study/CompetitorMatrix.tsx - Comparison table against CozZo, Frigopane, SuperCook, Bring!, Too Good To Go
components_structure.UnitEconomicsCalculator: @/components/study/UnitEconomicsCalculator.tsx - Interactive calculator with sliders (Utenti 100/1k/10k, scontrini/mese, ricette AI/giorno, prezzo abbonamento €) and break-even projection
components_structure.CostCharts: @/components/study/CostCharts.tsx - Recharts breakdown of LLM OCR, Database, Hosting, and Net Margin
components_structure.ReceiptUploadModal: @/components/prototype/ReceiptUploadModal.tsx - Receipt scanner simulator (sample receipt images or file upload) with OCR parsing state
components_structure.AbbreviationConfirmation: @/components/prototype/AbbreviationConfirmation.tsx - Table/Cards to fix parsed receipt items (name expansion, storage location, category, shelf life degradation factor or real expiry override)
components_structure.DigitalPantryTimeline: @/components/prototype/DigitalPantryTimeline.tsx - Pantry items categorized by urgency: Rosso (1-2 giorni), Giallo (3-5 giorni), Verde (> 5 giorni), with quick actions: Consumato / Aperto / Gettato
components_structure.RecipeGenerator: @/components/prototype/RecipeGenerator.tsx - Daily AI recipe generation strictly prioritizing soonest expiring ingredients with nutrition tags
components_structure.JarvisMorningTelegram: @/components/prototype/JarvisMorningTelegram.tsx - Morning alert card simulator with Telegram Bot Token, Chat ID input, and 'Invia Notifica Test'

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a dual-mode interactive application in Italian: Mode A = Studio di Fattibilità (comprehensive 7-chapter report with clear visual badges for Verified data vs Estimates, competitor benchmarks, tech architecture, legal considerations, and live Recharts unit economics calculator) and Mode B = Prototipo Operativo (real-time receipt photo upload -> abbreviation confirmation -> digital pantry degradation timeline -> smart anti-waste recipe suggestions -> Jarvis/Telegram test dispatch).
Support Italian number & currency formats: € (EUR) with comma decimal or standard format (e.g., 2,99 € / mese, 1.000 utenti).

Include pre-seeded realistic Italian grocery receipts (e.g. 'LATTE PS UHT 1L', 'PETTO POLLO BIO', 'INSALATINA MISTA', 'RICOTTA VACCINA 250G', 'BANANE BIO', 'PASSATA POMOD. 700G') with pre-calculated degradation curves based on storage type (Frigo, Dispensa, Freezer) and open/closed state.

Implement the full 7-chapter feasibility content in clear, accessible language for a non-technical reader, as explicitly requested by the user, while keeping rigorous numbers and verified sources (e.g., Waste Watcher International 2024, ISTAT 2024, OpenAI/Claude Token Pricing 2025/2026, GDPR EU 2016/679, Regolamento UE 1169/2011 per allergeni).
Ensure 'Ricomincia' reset button works with a confirmation dialog to wipe demo pantry items and restore default state.
All interactive elements must include descriptive data-testid attributes for testing.
